objective: Phase 5: Make evaluation statistically defensible with pre-registered protocol, simulation power analysis, run manifest, paired tests, and multiplicity correction
acceptance_criteria: study/protocol.yaml freezes hypotheses (H1-H4), primary/secondary endpoints, models, temperatures, and exclusion rules before confirmatory evaluation
study/power.py implements simulation-based power analysis calculating required trials per scenario under target effect size and alpha=0.05 with multiplicity adjustment

src/xproto/stats.py implements Wilson CI, Newcombe Risk Difference CI, Risk Ratio CI, McNemar paired tests, Holm-Bonferroni multiplicity correction, and bootstrap latency percentiles (median, p95, p99)
results/run_manifest.json records git commit, scenario manifest hash, dependencies, seeds, model digests, timeouts, and per-observation execution provenance
src/xproto/eval.py reports raw k/n, effect sizes, risk difference, risk ratio, confidence intervals, and latency distributions rather than point estimates alone
tests/test_statistics.py verifies all statistical algorithms, effect size CIs, Holm-Bonferroni adjustments, and power simulation
non_goals: Do not implement Phase 6 AgentDojo and InjecAgent external benchmark adapters yet
